title: Relevant Stablecoin-related Activities
summary: This is an HKMA circular dated 27 May 2026, titled "Relevant Stablecoin-related Activities." Beyond its title, publication date, and regulator, this card cannot describe the circular's substantive content -- including which entities it addresses and what activities it covers: repeated attempts to fetch it from HKMA's document repository (brdr.hkma.gov.hk) during this analysis all returned HTTP 503 Service Unavailable, consistent with a persistent, previously-documented access problem affecting that subdomain rather than a one-off failure. This card classifies it under the Stablecoins pillar based on its title alone; it should be revisited and its classification and summary confirmed once the repository is reachable and the primary text can be read directly.
why_it_matters: HKMA issuing a circular specifically titled "Relevant Stablecoin-related Activities" signals continued, active regulatory attention to stablecoin-related conduct in Hong Kong. For a newcomer, that is worth tracking, though this card could not confirm what specific activities or requirements the circular addresses because HKMA's document repository was unreachable during drafting.
